findings.text: The scalable table cleanup operation for a virtual machine discards paging state for direct roots and also covers roots already marked invalid, while leaving mirror roots used for confidential guests untouched in notifier context. It tolerates overlap with a concurrent fast discard participant by walking already cleared upper entries, and it omits translation flushing on the grounds that the machine is being torn down or its userspace controller has exited so no virtual processor can consume stale translations.

The full scalable table discard path must be entered with the virtual machine address lock held exclusively. The implementation asserts that ownership and relies on it to make walking upper entries safe despite a concurrent fast discard participant having yielded.
The architecture level shadow flush operation is a thin delegation to the generic full discard routine, exposing a single call that drops all shadow paging state for the given virtual machine.

Early x86 memory management initialization resolves an undecided huge page mitigation setting by consulting host vulnerability and mitigation state, preserves the administrator requested scalable table mode for later vendor resolution, and then initializes the software entry layer.
Early entry initialization preserves the administrator desire for input output caching for later vendor resolution and records the host maximum physical address width for subsequent mask decisions.

Host address width discovery prefers the raw processor reported width when the relevant extended leaf is available, so that memory encryption key identifier bits are not mistaken for reserved bits, and otherwise falls back to the kernel recorded physical bits for unusual virtualized processors.

Vendor load initialization checks assumed widths of role descriptors, refreshes all entry masks, and allocates descriptor and page header caches with accounting, releasing any partial allocation and reporting resource exhaustion on failure.
Vendor unload and failure paths release both memory management caches and clear their handles, providing shared teardown between initialization failure and module exit.

Mask reset establishes default permission and tracking bits for shadow entries, enables accessed and dirty support, clears extended and encryption related masks, and installs host and memory management writability defaults. When the host is susceptible to a caching side channel it carves a high bit range for nonpresent or reserved marking and derives a lower guest frame mask from the remaining width.

Input output entry pattern installation honors the preserved caching desire, rejects patterns that overlap reserved frame bits or side channel relocation bits or that use bits outside the allowed set, and disables caching when the value is empty or would collide with the frozen entry pattern or fail self masking.

The execute disable huge page control accepts named modes and boolean spellings, with automatic mode following host vulnerability and mitigation state. A permanent disable mode is irreversible and only allowed when no virtual machines exist, while attempts to change a permanently disabled control are denied and unrecognized values are rejected.

Mutation of the huge page mitigation control serializes against virtual machine creation and, on an effective change, iterates all virtual machines to discard mappings under per machine slot exclusion and to request background recovery work.

Per virtual machine recovery threading moves from absent before first execution, to created once on demand after initialization, to periodically active or sleeping based on mitigation enablement and timing, and finally to stopped during teardown. Wake requests are safe when the thread is still absent and publication becomes visible only after startup completes.

Recovery timing is disabled when mitigation is off or the configured ratio is zero, uses an explicit period when configured, and otherwise derives an hourly quota divided by a capped ratio with a one second floor. Reconfiguration that enables recovery or shortens the period wakes all virtual machine workers.

Recovery work per address translation mode is bounded by a quota derived from outstanding candidates and the configured ratio, touches only direct pages still marked as disallowed, removes each visited candidate from accounting regardless of outcome, defers pages under dirty tracking for later bulk recovery, and batches visibility handling across interruptions.

Recovery holds source scoping and address lock protection across the scan, using shared mode for the scalable table and exclusive mode for the legacy table, plus a dedicated list lock for scalable candidates and read copy update coverage for table freeing, yielding cooperatively when scheduling or lock contention is indicated.

Scalable table candidate discard succeeds only for pages belonging to that table that retain a parent pointer and whose parent entry still references the same child table, with an atomic transition to a nonpresent value providing the decision point against concurrent modifiers.

A concurrent replacement of a non leaf entry by a leaf mapping, another table, or a cleared value must not be mistaken for the expected child, and frozen values must never be discarded as present. A lost atomic race is treated as a benign skip rather than an error.

Candidate discard for the scalable table requires the address lock held for reading at entry, reflecting that concurrent modifiers may still alter the parent entry and that validation plus atomic update must tolerate such races.

The pre change hook for guest memory privacy validates private memory support and a non empty range, proactively invalidates fully contained head and tail huge page extents that are currently uniform so that concurrent faults cannot materialize large mappings, and then unmaps the changing range using a filter opposite to the incoming privacy value.

Memory management role descriptors have fixed widths with page and extended page roles each occupying thirty two bits and processor roles occupying sixty four bits, and the vendor load path enforces these widths at build time to guard union aliasing assumptions.

The input output entry reservation uses physical address bit fifty one combined with the present bit when host width is below fifty two bits, and is disabled otherwise, with write and user access bits recorded as the associated access set.

Recovery wake requests tolerate absence of the background thread, which is expected before first execution when no huge page candidates can exist, by checking the published handle under single read semantics before signaling.

Permanent disablement of the huge page mitigation is irreversible for the lifetime of the module and interacts with virtual machine existence and recovery configuration, where further mitigation or timing changes are denied after it is engaged.

Dirty tracking determination for a shadow page uses a global counter fast path to avoid expensive slot lookup when tracking is impossible, accepting benign races during slot updates that affect only efficiency, and otherwise resolves the owning slot through the role appropriate view.
